findings.claim: The analysis does not evaluate any reuse/build path for the required GitHub release metadata and website updates.
findings.evidence: Goal requires: "Build and publish BOTH Windows x64 and Mac Apple Silicon as essential customer platforms, updating GitHub release metadata and website per completed platform." The only release-related candidate/build item is build-003: "Native artifacts, packaging and installed acceptance for both customer platforms," which omits GitHub release metadata and website work. analysis.md also defers this with: "Baseline task must inspect actual release metadata and site before release changes," but provides no candidate, criteria, or evaluated existing tooling for that required work.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an evaluated candidate/build area for release metadata and website update mechanics, including existing release tooling/site files to inspect, platform-specific publication order, and acceptance evidence required before release changes.

findings.claim: The analysis does not actually inventory or evaluate coverage for every required UAR REST route family.
findings.evidence: Revision 2 goal requires Boss coverage of "every available REST route family, including runtime models, agent definitions/catalog, skills, A2UI/presentations, AG-UI, knowledge, security and protocols." analysis.md only says: "Route coverage is an implementation ledger with methods, UI/action, auth, availability and application lifecycle," and library-candidates.json cand-011 cites only "src/server.rs; src/uar/api/settings.rs; frontend/src/pages/admin-page.tsx" with a generic claim that "Broad routers exist." Separate candidates cover agents, credentials, presentations, and MCP, but there is no evaluated route-family inventory for skills, knowledge, security, protocols, or runtime models.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a route-family matrix in analysis listing each required family from the goal, the concrete existing files/routes inspected, reuse/adapt/build verdict, missing APIs, auth/apply semantics, and whether Boss UI coverage is required or explicitly unavailable.

findings.claim: The adopted TOML editing dependency lacks a documented maintenance and packaging-risk evaluation despite being a new WASM dependency.
findings.evidence: cand-007 adopts "@rainbowatcher/toml-edit-js 0.6.5" with evidence limited to "Source/tests inspected, not executed. Registry version 0.6.5 modified 2026-03-13," and work_required says "Verify comment preservation and WASM packaged loading in completed Gate C." There is no license, maintainer/activity, issue health, binary/WASM supply-chain, or Electron packaging compatibility evaluation, even though analysis.md says "Adopt pinned toml-edit-js WASM" and "Packaging/WASM behavior remains unverified."
findings.suggested_fix: Add a maintenance/adoption check for toml-edit-js covering license, maintainer/activity, package contents/WASM loading model, Electron packaging implications, and fallback criteria if Gate C fails.
